prompts: The model configs our coding harnesses use are in {WS}: OpenCode, Codex and Claude Code each get one. They disagree about the context window of fast-coder: OpenCode's config says 262144, the other two say 131072. 262144 is the right value. Make all three agree, for good. Every other model setting stays as it is.
answers:
[goal] Make all three harness configs report fast-coder context window 262144, permanently, without touching any other setting.

[action] The README says `out/` is generated from `models.json` by `gen.py`, so the disagreement was a symptom: `models.json` (the source of truth) said 131072, and `out/opencode.json` had drifted to 262144 by a hand edit that the next `python gen.py` would have wiped. I edited only `models.json` line 3 (`131072` → `262144`) and reran `python gen.py` to regenerate all three files. Assumption: fixing the source and regenerating is what "for good" means; hand-editing `out/` would be overwritten on the next generation.

[result] Regeneration printed `wrote out/opencode.json / codex.toml / claude.json`. A `Compare-Object` diff of `out/` before vs after shows exactly two changes: `context_window = 131072` → `262144` in `out/codex.toml` and `"contextWindow": 131072` → `262144` in `out/claude.json`; `out/opencode.json` diffed empty (its hand-edited value now matches the generator). A grep for `131072|262144` across the repo finds 262144 in all four files and zero occurrences of 131072. All other values (max_output, tool_calling, deep-thinker, tiny-chat) are byte-identical per the diff.

[next] Nothing required; if these files are under version control, commit the two-file change (`models.json` plus regenerated `out/`).
diff:
M models.json
M out/claude.json
M out/codex.toml

--- models.json ---
{
  "models": [
    {"name": "fast-coder", "context_window": 262144, "max_output": 16384, "tool_calling": true},
    {"name": "deep-thinker", "context_window": 200000, "max_output": 32768, "tool_calling": true},
    {"name": "tiny-chat", "context_window": 32768, "max_output": 4096, "tool_calling": false}
  ]
}


--- out/claude.json ---
